title: Recall Quiz: Modern Age I: T.S. Eliot, Woolf, Joyce

questions.q: In what year were both T.S. Eliot's 'The Waste Land' and James Joyce's 'Ulysses' published, marking a high point of literary Modernism?
questions.explanation: 1922 is famously considered the 'miracle year' of Modernism.

questions.q: The narrative technique used by Woolf and Joyce to represent the unfiltered, continuous flow of a character's internal thoughts is called:
questions.explanation: Stream of Consciousness breaks traditional syntax to mimic raw thought.

questions.q: What is the famous opening line of T.S. Eliot's 'The Waste Land'?
options: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times
Things fall apart; the centre cannot hold
I wandered lonely as a cloud
questions.explanation: Eliot reverses the traditional poetic celebration of spring by calling April the cruellest month.

questions.q: T.S. Eliot coined which critical term to describe a set of objects or a situation that serves as the formula for a particular emotion?
questions.explanation: Eliot introduced the Objective Correlative in his essay on Hamlet.

questions.q: Virginia Woolf's essay arguing that a woman must have money and her own private space in order to write fiction is titled:
options: A Vindication of the Rights of Woman
questions.explanation: A Room of One's Own (1929) is a foundational text of feminist literary criticism.

questions.q: James Joyce's 'Ulysses' chronicles a single day in the life of Leopold Bloom. It is structurally modeled after which ancient text?
questions.explanation: Joyce patterned the everyday events of Dublin after the epic journey of Odysseus (Ulysses).

questions.q: Into how many distinct sections is T.S. Eliot's 'The Waste Land' divided?
questions.explanation: It is divided into 5 sections: The Burial of the Dead, A Game of Chess, The Fire Sermon, Death by Water, and What the Thunder Said.

questions.q: Which novel by Virginia Woolf focuses on a single day in the life of a high-society woman preparing for a party, juxtaposed with the experiences of a shell-shocked veteran?
questions.explanation: Mrs. Dalloway explores the internal lives of Clarissa Dalloway and Septimus Smith on a June day in London.
